request.notes: source/destination take system NAMES (not id64s). destination is a repeated form key (jQuery traditional:true), one per destination system, key name is SINGULAR 'destination' even though the site controller property is 'destinations'. final_destination is sent as an empty string when unset (jQuery serializes null as ''); when set it pins the last stop. loop=1 (site default) returns the route to source at the end. The parameters echo on /api/results/{job} renames destination->destinations.
